hero.title: Gamified FinDom, Ranks & Sim Rules
hero.subtitle: Discover Second Life's premier interactive economy: 50 progressive ranks, Gold Coin rewards, arcade gaming, active daily quests, and registered Dominants holding court in luxury.

manifesto.title: Making FinDom & Submissive Culture Fun Again
manifesto.lead: For years, Second Life FinDom has too often felt one-dimensional—silent tip jars and transactional scripts with no world to explore. Control & Chaos was engineered to change that forever.
manifesto.quote: FinDom should be an exhilarating game of status, devotion, luxury roleplay, and collective celebration.
paragraphs: We believe submission and dominance are interactive art forms. Our custom LSL Experience Cloud turns every interaction on the sim—from lively conversations in the Grand Ballroom to laser arena defense, arcade puzzle merge games, and sim-wide coin hunts—into tangible XP and Gold Coins.

Whether you are a Dominant looking to command devotion and build a loyal faction, or a Submissive striving to earn prestigious vanity titles and unlock exclusive privileges, Control & Chaos is your living playground.

ways_to_earn.title: Roleplay & Conversation
ways_to_earn.desc: Simply talking in local chat (3+ words, 15+ characters) awards +2 XP. Writing descriptive /me roleplay emotes awards +4 XP with an organic 90-second conversational cooldown.

ways_to_earn.title: Social Sit Radar
ways_to_earn.desc: Earn passive XP while lounging in the Grand Ballroom, Bar, or Lounge. Solo sitting awards +2 XP every 3 minutes. Couple sitting with a partner awards +3 XP every 5 minutes (250 XP/day cap).

ways_to_earn.title: Rotating Daily Quests
ways_to_earn.desc: Two fresh missions reset daily at midnight SLT at the main Terminal. Quests rotate through chat sessions, sitting, trivia answers, arcade games, and coin hunts for fast coin stacking.

ways_to_earn.title: Live DOM vs SUB Trivia
ways_to_earn.desc: Sim staff and event hosts launch live trivia rounds in local chat. First correct answer earns +15 XP, with +25 XP bonus twist rounds. Trivia scores are tallied by faction to crown weekly winners!

ways_to_earn.title: Greedy Dice Arcade
ways_to_earn.desc: The beloved Second Life Greedy dice game is fully integrated into the sim reward system. Joining a game grants +5 XP, winning rounds awards coins, and winning a full match awards +25 XP + Gold Coins.

ways_to_earn.title: Merge Game Arcade Cabinet
ways_to_earn.desc: Test your puzzle reflexes on the Darkmoon Edition Merge arcade cabinets. Earn 1 XP for every 10 points scored (up to 250 XP per game) plus Gold Coins upon game completion (150 Coins/day cap).

ways_to_earn.title: Sim-Wide Coin Hunt
ways_to_earn.desc: Explore secret nooks, high rafters, dungeon cells, and rooftop gardens. Hidden gold coins, rare token chests, and mystery multipliers refresh every 3 hours across the parcel.

ways_to_earn.title: Tribute Jars & FinDom Gifting
ways_to_earn.desc: Every Linden Dollar (L$) paid into a registered Dominant's Tribute Jar instantly converts into matching XP for both the gifter and recipient, powering your leveling while honoring your Domme.

ways_to_earn.title: DJ & Staff Tip Jars
ways_to_earn.desc: Show love to live sim performers, DJs, hosts, and stage dancers during scheduled events. Tipping awards instant XP bonuses and triggers celebratory ambient light beams across the ballroom.

ways_to_earn.title: Profile 'Picks' Loyalty
ways_to_earn.desc: Add Control & Chaos to your Second Life viewer profile Picks. Touch the Loyalty Board weekly to verify your profile link and collect +100 XP and +20 Gold Coins automatically.

ways_to_earn.title: Citizen Referral Program
ways_to_earn.desc: Invite friends or submissives to register on the sim. Once your referral reaches Level 5 in either faction, both of you are awarded +50 XP and a 10 Gold Coin referral bounty.

ways_to_earn.title: Cage Break Mini-Events
ways_to_earn.desc: Compete in the Neon Laser Cage Arena every Saturday at 1:00 PM SLT. Submissives work to hack laser locks while Dominants guard the cells. Top performers win huge XP pots and rare items.

reward_shop.title: Gold Coin Reward Exchange
reward_shop.subtitle: Convert your active gaming time and loyalty into exclusive Second Life rewards, vanity accessories, and VIP privileges at the main Terminal.

venue_gallery.title: Retro Arcade & Gaming Parlor

faqs.question: Is the Control & Chaos XP System free to join and play?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100% free! You do not need to spend any Linden Dollars to register, chat, sit on radar furniture, play Greedy dice, solve the Merge puzzle games, answer trivia, or climb through all 50 levels. Tributes and shopping simply offer bonus XP acceleration.

faqs.question: How do I choose between DOM and SUB factions?
faqs.answer: When you arrive at the sim, touch the Registration Terminal at the landing point. You will receive an Experience permission dialog and a menu to select either the Dominant (Empress/Master) or Submissive (Devoted/Bound) faction. You can request a faction change from sim staff if needed.

faqs.question: Do I need the Vow Collar or special mesh attachments to earn XP?
faqs.answer: No mesh collar is required to earn XP or level up. The Second Life Experience script operates entirely cloud-side. However, wearing certified hardware like the Vow Collar or PocketPig HUD unlocks automatic posture syncing, collar vanity badges, and RLV remote integration.

faqs.question: How do Gold Coins work compared to XP?
faqs.answer: XP is your permanent leveling score that determines your rank, title badge, and leaderboard standing (from Level 1 to Level 50). Gold Coins are the spendable currency you earn from quests, games, and coin hunts that can be exchanged at the terminal for items, vanity titles, and VIP lounge passes.

faqs.question: What are the daily Anti-AFK earning caps?
faqs.answer: To keep the sim vibrant and prevent unattended bot farming, passive earnings have healthy daily maximums (e.g., 250 XP/day for Social Sit radar, 150 Gold Coins/day for the Merge Game). Active gameplay like trivia, roleplay, and quests have generous separate caps that reset daily at midnight SLT.

faqs.question: Can I lose my XP, levels, or rank if I leave the sim?
faqs.answer: Never. All citizen statistics are securely stored in our cloud database via Second Life Experience KVP. Your rank, title, and Gold Coin balance will be waiting for you whenever you return to Control & Chaos or any affiliated estate parcel.

faqs.question: How do I become a Registered Dominant or get listed in the Directory?
faqs.answer: Verified Dominants who actively host sessions or maintain tribute jars on the sim can apply for a dedicated profile in our Service Providers Directory. Visit our Contact Concierge page or apply directly at the In-World Estate Office to set up your rate card and custom suite.

faqs.question: Are RLV restraints and FinDom interactions strictly consensual?
faqs.answer: Strictly and unconditionally consensual. All RLV devices respect viewer opt-in permissions and must feature immediate emergency release mechanisms. Our estate enforces a zero-tolerance policy against non-consensual griefing or harassment.

sim_rules.title: Consensual FinDom & D/s Etiquette
sim_rules.desc: All financial domination, tipping, service dynamics, and dominance protocols must be mutually consensual. Unsolicited demands or harassment in local chat will result in an immediate estate ejection.

sim_rules.title: RLV Safety & Emergency Release
sim_rules.desc: All RLV objects (cages, gags, collars, restraints) must respect user opt-in and allow wearer-triggered emergency release commands (/safeword or collar unlock) at all times.

sim_rules.title: Anti-AFK & Anti-Bot Policy
sim_rules.desc: Unattended macro bots, script spammers, and radar auto-clickers are strictly prohibited. Daily caps automatically protect the economy, and obvious automation scripts will be penalized.

sim_rules.title: Transparent Rates & Tributes
sim_rules.desc: All registered Dominants, escorts, and entertainers must maintain clear rate cards and tribute expectations. All tip jars and gaming tables run on transparent LSL logic.

quick_start.title: Teleport In-World
quick_start.desc: Arrive at Control & Chaos using the SLurl link. Accept the Experience permission prompt for seamless auto-tracking.

quick_start.title: Touch the Registration Terminal
quick_start.desc: Select your Faction (DOM or SUB) to receive your starter citizen titler HUD and view your initial daily quests.

quick_start.title: Play, Socialize & Level Up
